Why go: a large private speedboat at a group-friendly price

Sao is a triple-engine speedboat licensed for up to 40 people, which makes it a practical choice for larger families and groups of friends who want one boat for the whole party. It leaves from Bang Rak pier near the Big Buddha, the closest pier to Koh Phangan and Koh Tao, and the price includes a guide, snorkel gear and snacks.

Four routes are on offer. Koh Phangan is the shortest crossing and the cheapest day. The southern islands route links Koh Tan, Koh Madsum (Pig Island) and Koh Rap. Ang Thong and Koh Tao are the long days, with more time at sea.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: groups of 8–20, birthdays and family reunions, and anyone who wants the whole boat for one party.
  • Choose something else if you are a couple: a shared tour such as the Koh Tao day trip is much cheaper.
  • Want more comfort than speed? See our catamaran charters.

Good to know

  • Ang Thong: closed every year from 1 November to 15 December.
  • Getting to the pier: Bang Rak is 10–15 minutes from Chaweng and Bophut. Book the van if your group is larger than one taxi.
  • Fees: park and island fees are cash only.
  • Comfort: speedboats are bumpy in swell; pregnant guests and people with back problems should choose a calmer route or a bigger boat.

Choosing a route

For a first day out with mixed ages, the southern islands are the safe choice: short hops, sheltered water and a choice of beaches for lunch. Koh Phangan suits groups who want beach-hopping and a restaurant lunch on a longer coastline. Ang Thong and Koh Tao are the big scenic days, but they mean more time at speed in open water, which tires young children.
